# Java Migration Skills — Azure AKS Edition

Seven Copilot skills for Java modernization toward Azure/AKS.

Target platform:
- Azure Container Registry (ACR)
- Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
- Azure DevOps / Azure Pipelines
- Azure Key Vault and workload identity where appropriate

OpenShift is intentionally excluded.

Skills:
1. java-lts-migration
2. spring-boot-migration
3. legacy-to-kubernetes
4. rhel-to-aks-migration
5. jenkins-to-azure-pipelines
6. java-test-modernization
7. framework-migration
